landing.about_bio: Full-stack developer. I build ERPs, CRMs, and workflow automations with TypeScript — React, tRPC, Prisma, PostgreSQL, n8n.
landing.ai_point_1: Chat with RAG over your knowledge base
landing.ai_point_2: Extract orders from free-text or email
landing.ai_point_3: Ask data in plain language → read-only SQL
landing.automation_point_2: AI drafts and sends an HTML reply
landing.automation_point_3: Optional draft sales order on the thread
landing.faq_a_1: A sales management platform for field teams and back-office: customers, outlets, orders, visits, and approvals in one auditable system.
landing.faq_a_2: Field sales teams, distributors, and SMEs that need structured, auditable order and visit tracking.
landing.faq_a_3: Sales orders, action programs, event proposals, and visit logs share one ladder — Draft → Validating → Proposed → Approved or Rejected — with AI review and a logged audit trail. A rules-validated order skips the Validating step, and action programs and event proposals add four approval rungs while Proposed.
landing.faq_a_4: Yes. Customer email becomes an AI-drafted reply and an optional draft sales order. Order details go in the email body; attachments aren't processed yet.
landing.faq_a_5: Role-based access control, JWT authentication, and an activity log on PostgreSQL. Every mutation that changes business data is recorded against the user who made it; the one exception is re-embedding a knowledge-base entry, which only refreshes vector indexes.
